thread:
kyle: Solstice Health POC kickoff today. They require SSO (SAML + OIDC), SCIM for HR sync (bulk + deltas), RBAC mapped by AD orgUnit, and domain allowlist for sign-in. Can we run through preflight items?

mike: Quick check : Hosted POC or Dedicated? Network isolation or standard hosted?

kyle: Hosted to start. They specifically called out needing audit logs retained for 90 days during the POC. Any ops constraints?

raj: Audit retention >60 days triggers extra storage add-on for hosted POC; ops can enable 90d but will bill. For SCIM: recommend bulk initial sync + delta/JIT for realtime. Need scim token, endpoint, and expected sync window.

natalie: Security Qs incoming: encryption at rest, BYOK for keys (only on Dedicated), data residency for PHI concerns. Elaine, can you provide SOC/KMS blurbs?

elaine: SOC2 Type II summary + encryption-at-rest doc attached in Dropbox link (will post after meeting). For hosted: RSA AES-256, keys managed by Redwood; Dedicated supports customer KMS. Note: BYOK requires extra setup and lead time.

presales-bot: Created ticket POC-1766000000. Checklist items: idp-metadata, scim-token, rbac-mapping, audit-retention-quote, legal-qna.

mike: SCIM limits: we publish soft limit 120 req/min per tenant. 429 returns Retry-After. Recommend exponential backoff: 500ms -> 1s -> 2s. Example payload: ```POST /scim/v2/Users
Authorization: Bearer <token>
{ "schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:schemas:core:2.0:User"], "userName": "alex@solstice.health" }```

raj: For RBAC mapping we need a CSV from their AD with orgUnit -> group -> role mapping. We can do a temporary group-to-role mapping via SCIM Group membership if they prefer. Also note: delegated admin across subdomains requires org-level TXT proof.

kyle: Legal sent a 28-page security questionnaire. Main asks: deletion SLA, SCIM delta retention, domain proof process, pen-testing cadence. Any templates we can reuse?

elaine: Use our prefilled security QNA from the Meridian response set; deletion API: 30-day soft-delete + permanent wipe on request within 72 hours. SCIM deltas retained 14 days for retry/backfill in Hosted. Pen-test: yearly + on-demand for enterprise.

natalie: I'll own the security QNA upload and coordinate with their legal. Please drop Meridian bundle link in thread.

mike: Pricing note: we offer 45-day no-charge POC credits for new enterprise prospects. Audit retention and extended logs are billable add-ons. For Dedicated quotes we add a baseline commitment. Sarah from sales ops can provide a draft.

kyle: Action items: Natalie = security QNA + upload, Raj = RBAC mapping template + SCIM best-practices doc, Elaine = SOC/KMS docs, Mike = POC billing note and limits, Sarah (cc) = pricing one-pager. I'll schedule the kickoff call and ask whether they want bulk-only or bulk + JIT.

presales-bot: Reminder: schedule kickoff: https://cal.redwood.io/poc/1766000000

kyle: Thanks team. I'll update when kickoff time is confirmed. :white_check_mark:
